content: कोणः [कुण्-करणे घञ् कर्त्तरि अच् वा <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 A corner, an angle (of anything); भयेन कोणे क्वचन स्थितस्य <ls>Vikr. 1. 99</ls>; युक्तमेतन्न तु पुनः कोणं नयनपद्मयोः <ls>Bv. 2. 173</ls>. .²2 An intermediate point of the compass. .²3 The bow of a lute; a fiddle-stick. .²4 The sharp edge of a sword or weapon. .²5 A stick, staff, club. .²6 A drum-stick; … कोणैर्भेर्यो निजघ्निरे <ls>Bk. 14. 2</ls>. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of the planet Mars. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of the planet Saturn. .²9 A sort of musical instrument [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>Gr.</lang> {%gonia%}].
